chapter.heading: A psalm of thanksgiving.
chapter.v:
Shout with
joy to the Lord, all the earth!

Worship the
Lord with gladness.Come before him, singing with joy.

Acknowledge that
the Lord is God!He made us, and we are his.We are his people, the sheep of his pasture.

Enter his
gates with thanksgiving;go into his courts with praise.Give thanks to him and praise his name.

For the
Lord is good.His unfailing love continues forever,and his faithfulness continues to each generation.
